title: Blastoise Blasters on a Squirtle
subject: Squirtle and Blastoise blasters
opening_candidates_note: 1) Typicality 0.52 (disaster cliche): 'Bolt Blastoise blasters onto a Squirtle, and the first shot flips it across the room.' Discarded because the topic isn't toxic or explosive. 2) Typicality 0.18 (process_first_no_mistake): 'Wrap a padded steel band around a Squirtle's shell and tighten two top brackets.' Good, but less visually surprising. 3) Typicality 0.12 (rule_break_then_why): 'Clamp both Blastoise blasters onto a Squirtle's shell, then hammer brass plugs right into the open tips.' Selected for its immediate visual contradiction—plugging the barrels right at 0s hooks curiosity before revealing the flow-pinch payoff.

beats.vo_line: Clamp both Blastoise blasters onto a Squirtle's shell, then hammer brass plugs right into the open tips.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: Clamp both Blastoise blasters onto a Squirtle's shell
visual_cues.action: A wrench tightens a padded steel saddle clamp around a calm Squirtle's shell, securing two Blastoise blasters upright over its shoulders.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: hammer brass plugs right into the open tips
visual_cues.action: A rubber mallet taps two machined brass plugs snugly into the wide front openings of both barrels.

beats.vo_line: Bolt an iron weight onto the rear clamp so the heavy barrels won't tip it forward.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: Bolt an iron weight onto the rear clamp
visual_cues.action: A socket wrench bolts a compact iron block onto the back bracket of the steel clamp just above the Squirtle's tail.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: so the heavy barrels won't tip it forward
visual_cues.action: Camera settles into a side profile as the Squirtle leans slightly forward, then levels back onto flat feet thanks to the rear weight.

beats.vo_line: Strap a rubber cup under its chin, and run braided hoses through a splitter into both barrels.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: Strap a rubber cup under its chin
visual_cues.action: A soft strap fastens a small molded rubber funnel directly beneath the Squirtle's lower jaw.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: run braided hoses through a splitter into both barrels
visual_cues.action: A screwdriver tightens steel hose clamps connecting braided tubing from a brass Y-splitter into the rear ports of both Blastoise blasters.

beats.vo_line: Those brass plugs aren't solid—their tiny holes squeeze a Squirtle's gentle spit into a hard stream.

visual_cues.action: Cutaway view slices open the plugged muzzle to reveal a narrow funnel-shaped channel drilled straight through the brass.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: their tiny holes squeeze a Squirtle's gentle spit into a hard stream
visual_cues.action: Slow-moving blue water fills the wide barrel from the rear hose, then accelerates sharply as it squeezes through the tight brass opening.

beats.vo_line: As the Squirtle spits into the cup, both hoses swell until the barrels hum.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: As the Squirtle spits into the cup
visual_cues.action: The Squirtle puffs its cheeks and blasts water straight down into the rubber chin funnel.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: both hoses swell until the barrels hum
visual_cues.action: The braided hoses stiffen tight with surging water while both mounted barrels visibly vibrate against the steel clamp.

beats.vo_line: Place a red brick down the bench, and let it fire—twin jets snap that brick clean in half.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: Place a red brick down the bench
visual_cues.action: Steel tongs stand a single red clay brick upright at the far end of the workshop bench.
Twin needle-tight white-blue water jets blast forward out of the tiny holes in both brass plugs.

visual_cues.vo_trigger: twin jets snap that brick clean in half
visual_cues.action: The dual water jets punch straight through the center of the red brick, snapping it cleanly into two falling halves across the bench.
